name: Bureau Veritas S.A.
summary: Bureau Veritas S.A. functions as a leading provider of assessment services, encompassing laboratory analysis, examination, and accreditation for various industries. Its operations are structured into six distinct divisions: Maritime & Offshore, Agri-Food & Raw Materials, Industrial Sector, Construction & Infrastructure, Compliance Certification, and Consumer Goods. The company's core mission involves evaluating, scrutinizing, auditing, and authenticating its clients' offerings, properties, and organizational frameworks against both statutory and voluntary benchmarks, subsequently issuing verification documents. It also delivers analytical services, performed both in laboratories and at client sites, for manufacturing and processing sectors. Its inspection services are specifically designed to confirm quality, quantity, and adherence to legal requirements for a wide array of products, services, assets, and facilities. Furthermore, it offers certification programs for management systems, products, and individuals. Bureau Veritas extends its services to a diverse range of sectors, including automotive and transportation, building and infrastructure, chemicals, commodities and agriculture, consumer products and retail, food, marine and offshore, oil and gas, power and utilities, as well as financial services and public administration. The firm boasts an extensive global footprint, operating across approximately 140 nations through a network of 1,600 locations. Established in 1828, its headquarters are situated in Neuilly-sur-Seine, France.
